svg.title: Metadata-driven batch ingestion architecture in Microsoft Fabric
svg.desc: Fabric SQL Database stores ingestion configuration, watermarks, connection references and object audit results. A shared Fabric pipeline orchestrator selects requests, optionally paginates configurations, dispatches objects using ForEach, and routes them to SQL Server or SFTP adapters. SQL Server tables are loaded through query-based Copy directly to Lakehouse Bronze. SFTP CSV files use binary Copy to Lakehouse Landing, then a Notebook parses them into Bronze. Power BI summarizes SQL audit results and Fabric Monitor shows pipeline runs.
svg.metadata: Microsoft Fabric SQL Database, Pipeline, Notebook, and Lakehouse pictograms are unmodified SVG artwork from the official Microsoft Fabric icon package published by Microsoft. They are included here only to illustrate Microsoft Fabric architecture. All other activity/source pictograms are generic diagram symbols.
svg.text: One control layer coordinates shared pipelines and two ingestion paths into Lakehouse Bronze.
Guarded watermarks · object audits · failure cleanup
Power BI report · Fabric Monitor pipeline runs
CONCEPTUAL OVERVIEW · NOT A PIPELINE CANVAS OR RUNTIME TRACE
